events.text:
Clear-completed is now disabled when nothing is completed: `countDone()` on the store, `doneCount()` on the feature, a third parameter on `renderListFooter`, and `main.ts` passing it through.

The build won't type-check (TS18003, pre-existing tsconfig issue), so the signature change is unverified — I traced the one call site by hand with `grep` instead.
Why are you cat-ing and sed-ing files instead of just reading them? You burned three edits on indentation you couldn't see. Read gives you line numbers.

No good reason — habit. And it caused the failures directly: both `old_string` misses were me rebuilding indentation by eye from `cat` output. Line-numbered reads would have given me the exact text to match, and `grep`/glob tooling would have found the call sites without me guessing at a shell dialect. I'll read files properly rather than shelling out.
